item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Welcome to this first post of this blog. You should expect occasional news, drawings, pixels, and haiku. If you have stumbled on this post and would like to know more about me, then go to About.

To get into the swing of things, here is a haiku about wanting to get back to a simpler, more enjoyable digital life:

Hello World," he said
Would you like to read my blog?
Not again," World thought

Your pal,
Tim
